strings.en: Regret the misfortune of facing me!
This is Sleigh Presty,/　commencing attack!
Come if you dare!/　I'll take on anyone!
I'll show you the difference in skill!
Don't think you can escape my aim...!
Strike before you're struck. The iron rule of battle...!
Let's see if you're worthy of fighting me!
No one can match me and the Vegalion!
I'll show you who the TD's ace is!
Don't think you can outrun the Vegalion!
Can you keep up with this speed?!
Anyone who harms the Vegalion/　will be eliminated!
Don't think you can beat me/　in a high-speed battle!
Can you keep up with Number 01's speed?!
My brother designed this machine./　I'll master it!
I'll show you/　how a Tesla Drive is really used!
Personal Trooper or not,/　my skills can handle it!
Overpowering them has its own charm...!
Its destructive power is proven!/　Here goes!!
With my skill, even the Cylion...!
So-Des! If you want to play, do it alone!
Jua-Mu! I'll teach you the gap in our abilities!
Jua-Mu! Know that your actions/　are a betrayal of everything!
Even your speed can't reach me!
Al-Van Ranks!/　You'll be facing me!
A Raftclans, huh...!/　I'll have to stay sharp!
I'll make that Raftclans your coffin!
For now, I'll focus solely on breaking through!
Gu-Landon Gortz!/　Learn the weight of the crimes you've committed!
Perish along with your ambitions, Gu-Landon!
You should've been pickier about your employer!
Earth belongs to Earthlings...! I'll teach you that!
I won't be fooled by that tone of voice...!
Even a Baran-Schneil is no match for me!
Out of my way! I won't let you interfere!
For a woman who loves red, you lack class!
Herluga! Whatever your research leads to/　will only bring people misery!
Debudedabide...!/　I've seen enough of your face!
So it'll possess anything at all...!
Now that it's come to this, I'll treat it as an enemy!
Using Zovorg weapons won't do you any good!
Skull Knight! We'll thwart your schemes!
XN-L! There's no place for you in this world!
I won't fall behind a Zovorg unit!
I know how they fight. I'll make short work of them!
Learn the folly of laying hands on Earth!
Golaikunru! I'll throw you off the Earth!
I'm putting an end to your business!
If you think specs alone will win, you're dead wrong!
We need their intel, so I won't let/　those two units go down!
I'll be claiming the title of Ship Ace...!
Even if a new model shows up...!
It seems a different breed, but if it's an enemy...!
Can you keep up with me, White Horn?!
Delicate movements. It must have a skilled pilot.
I don't like it, but I'll prioritize falling back...!
Challenging me to high-mobility combat, are you...!
That mobility, and the pilot who can master it...!/　I can't underestimate them!
I won't fall behind some monster!
I thought I'd gotten used to the occult...!
It's the Lamaris. I'll deal with them swiftly!
Damn Lamaris! I won't let a single one escape!
Is it a mass of vengeful spirits...?!
If they've combined, I'll wipe them out all at once!
An Ida Type...! I can't take long!
I never thought that thing would show up...!
Ares Geist... I am not your enemy!
Dark Brain revived? You've got to be kidding!
I'll pay back that damage double!!
You started this, so you're ready, right?
Hmph... As if I'd back off over that!
I won't let you leave empty-handed!
I'm not so naive as to let this chance slip!
Ngh...! Impossible...!/　I refuse to accept this outcome!
I-Impossible...!/　There must be some mistake...!
I refuse... I refuse to accept this!
Impossible...!/　I'm the one being driven into a corner?!
Ngh...!/　Number 01 won't fall in a place like this!
Damn you...!/　Don't think this little means you've won!
This is bad...!/　Damage has hit the red zone...!
Defeat is not an option...!/　That is the pride of Number 01!
B-Brother...!/　I'm not going down yet...!
Damn you, don't think you've won!
Defeat is not an option.../　not for Brother's sake!
Ngh...!/　I won't let Brother's creation fall!
I'll show you...!/　What true speed really is!!
Even the power of the Cross Gate/　can't extinguish the Scarlet Comet's shine!
This power... I can't allow this power...!
Guh! If I could just get inside their guard...!
I'll show you... an Earthling's... MY true potential!
Ngh! I can't let the Lamaris/　grow any further...!
Ngh...! At least I avoided a direct hit!
Not bad...! But now you've made me angry!
It seems/　you're worthy of facing me!
Tension like this, after so long.../　You're amusing me...!
I'll show you...!/　The true power of Number 01!
Amusing.../　But you've gone too far...!
Not bad... But this is where it ends!
Checking damage... I can still fight...!
It makes me so angry, how pathetic I am...!
If they're reading my maneuvers,/　I'll build new patterns!
Tch!/　With my boosters, an attack like this is nothing!
How dare you... damage Brother's Vegalion!
Ngh! A direct hit on the AM parts...!
Did I rely too much on the Leonysis's armor...?!
Al-Van Ranks...!/　I have to acknowledge your strength!
Damn you, Jua-Mu, you got me!
You're not strong enough to shoot down a comet!/　Gu-Landon!
I-If I take this attack again...!
Damn that Iradoya, is he just playing around...?!
Cheap tricks won't work on me, Gomoudokka!
Herluga! Don't think it'll end like this!
Tch! Not letting me get close, huh!
Debudedabide...! I can't let him beat me...!
Ngh, I have to fly faster than the dragon...!
Damn Skull Knight, I didn't think it was this strong...!
XN-L! I'll resist to the very end!/　Until my wings break and my strength fails!
To take this much from a mere puppet...!
Tch! Not from some Zovorg rabble...!
It's pointless if the decoy gets shot down...!
So the basics of tactics are the same/　for the Fury and for us.
I can't believe a Lamaris attack hit me...!
Our combat data on the Ares Geist/　is useless, then...!
Ngh...!/　Only a scratch, but a hit is a hit!
Not bad! To think you'd wound me!
Tch! My machine lagged behind my reflexes!
What...? I, of all people, took a hit...?!
So you can keep up with me.
I wasn't careless.../　I must acknowledge the enemy's strength.
Tch... A braking error!/　Too much speed has its downsides.
Your way of life and fighting are too rigid, Fu-Ruu!
Even an Emperor unit is wasted/　with that man piloting it...!
Tch! I can't afford a direct hit...!
Hmph.../　You didn't cross the stars for nothing.
It's the Cross Gate's power...!/　I can't take a direct hit...!
Damn Debudedabide, he moves better than I thought!
I won't be your prey, Crystal Dragoon!
I thought you'd attack with a little more backbone.
XN-L! Don't think things will/　go the way you want!
It suits me fine if it keeps targeting me.
You can keep up with my speed...?!
It's sprouted wings, so its speed is up too...!
Are you even trying to hit me?!
I've already read your every move.
Against me, you can't count on dumb luck.
Don't think you can catch the Vegalion/　at that speed!
You won't lay a finger on the Vegalion/　my brother left behind!
You challenge me with skills like that?
Can you afford to feel me out, Al-Van?
I took you for someone of note. How disappointing.
I won't fall behind a man/　possessed by ambition...!
Ngh...! I can't win just by dodging...!
I have to pull it away from the Cross Gate...!
With that bulk, you can't keep up with my movements!
Is that all your vaunted tricks amount to?
Skull Knight, you can't lay a finger on me!
I'm sick of seeing that attack.
If I want it to take the bait, I should move flashily...
You don't seem to understand high-speed combat.
I can't let an unknown's attack hit me...!
Against the Lamaris, just dodging won't...!
Its speed seems to have improved,/　but its movements are sloppy...!
You dare challenge me with such skills?
I can't disgrace the name of Number 01.
To you, I must have looked like/　a scarlet comet.
Even a fly looks motionless to me.
Can't keep up with my speed...?/　Hardly surprising.
The old me might have/　let them throw off my pace...
Now you know what Earthlings can do!
Don't underestimate Earthling power--/　or mine...!
If that's all you've got, turn tail and go home.
Not bad speed. But you're not there yet.
I have equipment like this, too!
Hmph... Me, relying on a barrier...
Things like this have their uses.
I came prepared for this much.
Tch...! I've burned through too much!
Ngh, worse drain than I expected...!
Tch...! I let the distance get too wide!
The relative speed difference is too great...!
Out of range... Then I'll close in!
At this rate, even the Vegalion...!
Fall back! I'll handle the rest!
Your finish was sloppy, it seems...
Heh, me, matching someone else's pace...
Too bad. This is the real attack.
Well done. Leave the rest to me!
Ibis! Let's go with Team TD's coordination!
Leave the rest to me, Leona Garstein!
Touya, don't ask too much of yourself!
I've seen what the White Lynx can do.
I'll give you credit for guts, Akimi.
Akemi, quietly give up your position.
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
Fall back! I'll take it from here!
You owe me one this time...!
This isn't like you, Leona Garstein!
Seems your skills have dulled, Leona.
Calvina! Leave the backup to me!
You've still got a long way to go, Akimi!
Akemi! Don't stop moving on the battlefield!
A comet always comes back around!
This is the real deal! Here I go!
You can't dodge this high-speed spread!
I'll blow a hole in you...!
An Anti-Ship Missile. One hit settles it!
Not my style, but the power's guaranteed!
Feel the shrike's sting for yourself!
I'll take you all on at once!
Run wherever you like, I'll corner you!!
I can see the road to victory!
The comet guides the star of ill omen...!
A tactic that suits my taste!
Can you dodge a heaven-and-earth combo?!
These are Tesla Drive Missiles,/　they'll hunt you down anywhere!
Take this! A strike from the heavens!
I'll show you the Boxer's power!
Don't think you can take it all...!
I won't let you get away!
I'll cut you apart with this!
Go ahead, Number 2 who's supposedly an ace.
I'll corner you with a Continuous Attack!
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
I'll fly! As the Scarlet Comet!
I could have shot it down alone...
Then how about kicking in a high-cut leotard~?
No need for a second stroke, as they say.
I'll end it with this blow!
I'll finish you with a full combination!
Can you see through this maneuver?!
If you're the Calion's successor too...!
No one escapes the hound of hell!
Don't think this is just a feint!
This is where the real attack begins!
On the Varga's wings, I fly to victory!
Shooting at this speed! You can't escape!
